description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing a shopping cart in an e-commerce application. It includes type definitions for cart items and context, functions to add, remove, update, and clear cart items, as well as hooks for accessing the cart state and actions.

methods.name: getStorageCart
methods.description: Retrieves the cart data from local storage, parsing the JSON string into an array of CartItem objects.

methods.name: CartProvider
methods.description: React component that provides cart state and actions via context to its children.

methods.name: useCart
methods.description: Custom hook to access cart context, throwing an error if used outside of the CartProvider.
